t: Tomas Hertl: News, Stats, Game Logs | RotoWire
s: Hertl was limited to 54 regular-season appearances between Vegas and San Jose in 2023-24, earning 17 goals, 38 points and 124 shots on net. He underwent knee surgery in mid-February and missed 26 contests from Jan 30 to April 5. Hertl registered two goals and two assists in six regular-season outings with the Golden Knights after being acquired from the Sharks on March 8.
